goal: Prevent CPU-exhausting busy loops in network event handling caused by TCP urgent data
Avoid bypassing receive backpressure on socket errors when reads are paused
agreement: Substantive support for eliminating select loops on urgent data (darosior, midnightmagic)
Suggests unifying behavior by always disconnecting on exceptions across all platforms (theuni, darosior)
Asks for the rationale and usefulness of the second commit (darosior)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it protects nodes against CPU exhaustion and busy loops in the P2P event loop
TCP urgent data triggers select ready states without data to read, stalling the thread

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it protects the embedded HTTP server against similar socket exception busy loops
Marginal because HTTP connections are typically local or trusted
